title: Fix: add a parcel to the end

ticket.subject: Parcel appears in the wrong place
ticket.body: with_extra should keep every parcel and add the new one at the end. The current code overwrites the last parcel, and it fails on an empty list.

rules: The result keeps every item and adds extra at the end.
An empty list gives a list with only extra.

title: Fix: total the first few parcels

ticket.subject: Totals skip a parcel
ticket.body: first_total should add the first n weights. The current loop starts at the wrong index, so the first weight is missing.

rules: Add up the first n values.
When n is 0, the total is 0.

title: Fix: add a stop to a route

ticket.subject: Stops leak between routes
ticket.body: add_stop should start a new route when none is given. Right now stops from one route appear in the next.

rules: The stop is added to the end of the list it is given.
A call without a list starts a new list.

title: Structure: squares of odd values

ticket.subject: Odd weights, squared
ticket.body: Write squares_of_odds(values). Use a comprehension, not a loop.

rules: Build the result with a comprehension, and use no for or while loop in the function.

structureChecks.label: use no for or while loop in squares_of_odds

title: Structure: a countdown generator

ticket.subject: Countdown for the board
ticket.body: Write countdown(n). It yields n, n-1, and so on down to 1. Use yield, and do not build a list.

rules: Produce the values with yield, and build no list.

structureChecks.label: do not call list in countdown
